d: Pale pink hair is styled with blunt bangs and two very long, thin braids that loop around the body, tied with crimson ribbons. The eyes are a deep navy blue with a calm, neutral expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender build is dressed in a white short-sleeved crop top with gold trim, paired with tight dark navy leggings that feature gold accents at the waist and gold bands around the calves of the dark navy boots. A gold tiara rests atop the head.
